pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal dark regions with smooth pixel-level gradients at the edges. The spatial area of the patches is greatest on the mid-flank and decreases significantly toward the ventral margin.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light pelage. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial. The pixel thickness of these pathways is relatively narrow and consistent across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette along the neck and shoulder ridge formed by dark hair fibers.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A distinct structural break and thinning of the mane density is visible at the transition point between the posterior neck and the shoulder ridge.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A large, prominent area of textural disruption and de-pigmentation is visible on the dorsal aspect of the shoulder, characterized by a smooth, light-grey surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive depigmented and texturally altered patch on the upper shoulder ridge, consistent with significant skin trauma or a chronic lesion.
other_distinctive_markers: Partial occlusion of the primary subject's anterior flank by the posterior section of a second individual in the foreground.
